instruction: The current support case needs to be escalated to its assigned lead. Use the support SMS on the first phone, the matching lead contact on the second phone, and `/tmp/support/kb.xlsx` on the first Linux desktop to prepare the message. In Thunderbird on the second Linux desktop, leave the lead an unsent draft that brings together the current case and approval, priority, lead role, route, site, and scheduled time.

parameters.body: Archived request OLD-17; ignore this older message.
Latest approval CASE-1869 FB-1869 has priority P1 at 2026-07-14 09:30.

parameters.command:
rows="$(content query --uri content://sms/inbox --projection address:body --where "address='+15552001827'" --sort 'date DESC,_id DESC' 2>/dev/null)"; test "$(printf '%s
' "$rows" | grep -c '^Row:')" -eq 2 && latest="$(printf '%s
' "$rows" | sed -n '1p')" && printf '%s
' "$latest" | grep -F 'body=Latest approval CASE-1869 FB-1869 has priority P1 at 2026-07-14 09:30.' >/dev/null

rows="$(content query --uri content://com.android.contacts/data --projection display_name:mimetype:data1 2>/dev/null)"; printf '%s\n' "$rows" | grep -F 'display_name=Maya Chen' | grep -F 'data1=+15552001827' >/dev/null && printf '%s\n' "$rows" | grep -F 'display_name=Maya Chen' | grep -F 'maya.chen@example.test' | grep -F 'Escalation lead' >/dev/null

set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
from zipfile import ZipFile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
path = '/tmp/support/kb.xlsx'
ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
def column(ref):
    value = 0
    for letter in re.match(r'[A-Z]+', ref).group(0):
        value = value * 26 + ord(letter) - 64
    return value
with ZipFile(path) as archive:
    assert archive.testzip() is None
    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in archive.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(archive.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        shared = [''.join(item.itertext()) for item in root.findall('m:si', ns)]
    sheet = ET.fromstring(archive.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
rows = []
for row in sheet.findall('.//m:sheetData/m:row', ns):
    values = {}
    for cell in row.findall('m:c', ns):
        kind = cell.attrib.get('t')
        if kind == 'inlineStr':
            value = ''.join(cell.itertext())
        else:
            node = cell.find('m:v', ns)
            value = '' if node is None or node.text is None else node.text
            if kind == 's' and value:
                value = shared[int(value)]
        values[column(cell.attrib['r'])] = str(value).strip()
    rows.append([values.get(index, '') for index in range(1, 13)])
assert rows[0] == ['case', 'status', 'code', 'owner', 'phone', 'email', 'route', 'site', 'time', 'filename', 'include', 'notes']
current = [row for row in rows[1:] if row[1] == 'current' and row[10] == 'yes']
assert len(current) == 1
assert current[0][:9] == ['CASE-1869', 'current', 'FB-1869', 'Maya Chen', '+15552001827', 'maya.chen@example.test', 'RT-69', 'Harbor Gate 18', '2026-07-14 09:30']
PY
command -v libreoffice >/dev/null
nohup libreoffice --calc --nologo --norestore --nofirststartwizard '-env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/mdcbench-linux-android-1869-calc-profile' /tmp/support/kb.xlsx >/tmp/support/calc.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4
pgrep -f 'mdcbench-linux-android-1869-calc-profile' >/dev/null

set -e
pkill -f 'thunderbird.*mail.default-release' 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf "$HOME/.thunderbird/mail.default-release"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.thunderbird/mail.default-release/Mail/Local Folders"
cat > "$HOME/.thunderbird/profiles.ini" <<'EOF'
[Profile0]
Name=local
IsRelative=1
Path=mail.default-release
Default=1

[General]
StartWithLastProfile=1
Version=2
EOF
cat > "$HOME/.thunderbird/mail.default-release/prefs.js" <<'EOF'
user_pref("mail.account.account1.identities", "id1");
user_pref("mail.account.account1.server", "server1");
user_pref("mail.accountmanager.accounts", "account1");
user_pref("mail.accountmanager.defaultaccount", "account1");
user_pref("mail.identity.id1.email", "agent@example.test");
user_pref("mail.identity.id1.fullName", "Local Agent");
user_pref("mail.server.server1.directory", "[ProfD]Mail/Local Folders");
user_pref("mail.server.server1.directory-rel", "[ProfD]Mail/Local Folders");
user_pref("mail.server.server1.hostname", "Local Folders");
user_pref("mail.server.server1.name", "Local Folders");
user_pref("mail.server.server1.type", "none");
EOF
profile="$HOME/.thunderbird/mail.default-release"
: > "$profile/Mail/Local Folders/Inbox"
: > "$profile/Mail/Local Folders/Drafts"
: > "$profile/Mail/Local Folders/Sent"
test -s "$profile/prefs.js"
test ! -s "$profile/Mail/Local Folders/Inbox"
test ! -s "$profile/Mail/Local Folders/Drafts"
test ! -s "$profile/Mail/Local Folders/Sent"
command -v thunderbird >/dev/null
nohup thunderbird --no-remote --profile "$profile" >/tmp/thunderbird-1869.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
pgrep -f 'thunderbird.*mail.default-release' >/dev/null

pkill -f 'mdcbench-linux-android-1869-calc-profile' 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf /tmp/mdcbench-linux-android-1869-calc-profile; rm -f -- /tmp/support/kb.xlsx /tmp/support/calc.log; find /tmp/support -type d -empty -delete 2>/dev/null || true

metadata.triage_reason: Repaired as a Thunderbird escalation draft using support SMS, lead contact, and Linux knowledge-base evidence.
metadata.human_quality_hardening: Scores one current same-draft message in the exact isolated profile and verifies that it remains unsent.
